channel.title: FINC409/609 - Fixed Income Securities
channel.description: Course Description This course provides an introduction to fixed income markets and the analytical tools used by market participants. Fixed income markets have evolved significantly in recent years, particularly following the global financial crisis. Regulatory changes, unconventional monetary policy and extended periods of very low or near-zero nominal interest rates, increased government borrowing, shifts in the empirical behavior of U.S. Treasury securities, and the introduction of new fixed income instruments have all influenced how these markets function and how fixed income securities are priced and risk-managed.
